title: External converter runtime and version-specific MLEADER handoff
mode: Primary-source research plus local plan reconciliation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Review the external ODA File Converter runtime boundary used by optional DWG-to-DXF consumer routes.
Inspect peer reports for version-specific MLEADER conversion behavior and distinguish route observations from codec defects.
Refine existing FreeCAD and MLEADER composed qualification gates without adding routine test dependencies or blocking local implementation.

sources.revision: Stable integration documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; executable was not run
sources.observation: The add-on invokes a separately installed converter. The guide lists mappings through AC1021/R2007, AC1027/R2013, and AC1032/R2018; it says Linux GUI suppression may require xvfb and documents no known solution for macOS GUI suppression.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Optional converter environment/setup guidance only; it does not qualify ODA output, FreeCAD's selected converter, or libdxfrw behavior.

sources.revision: Open issue body/activity reviewed 2026-10-19; report concerns ODA File Converter 26.9 Qt6 Linux RPM
sources.observation: The reporter says the installed package aborted with status 134 because the Qt xcb platform plugin could not initialize. A commenter suggested missing Qt/XCB runtime dependencies and mentioned xvfb for a Debian container.
sources.evidenceCeiling: One reporter's platform/package failure, not a universal dependency requirement or a libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: Open issue body/activity reviewed 2026-10-19; ezdxf 1.1.4b2 named by reporter, ODA build not identified
sources.observation: The issue reports MULTILEADER loss in an odafc.readfile()/odafc.export_dwg() route for an R2007 source. The maintainer says newly authored R2007 DXF MLEADER was not affected and recommends converting the source to R2013 first; the reporter says this workaround resolved the case. The attached drawing was not downloaded or inspected.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Version- and workflow-specific peer observation only. It does not isolate a failing stage, establish a format rule, or implicate ezdxf, ODA, FreeCAD, or libdxfrw independently.

sources.revision: Mutable main source rechecked 2026-10-19; local plan already pins its explicit test-local converter route
sources.observation: The DWG import workflow delegates to a selected external converter and then imports the DXF; the existing plan pins the required local dwg2dxf route and records process status, intermediate output, importer, and object outcomes separately.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Route-design context only; no FreeCAD or converter execution was performed in this research pass.

localEvidence: The current parity plan already scopes required FreeCAD qualification to an explicit local dwg2dxf path, avoiding automatic converter fallback.
The MLEADER plan already separates DXF MULTILEADER entities from DWG MLEADER payload/context routes and has a composed consumer checkpoint.
The new research adds only an optional ODA runtime preflight and preserve-version versus R2013-upversioned evidence separation.

assessment.planImpact: Adds runtime preflight and error classification only for an optional ODA comparator, and preserves R2007 versus R2013-upversioned MLEADER results as distinct composed evidence. It adds no local defect or implementation blocker.

method.kind: Read primary project integration documentation and issue reports, then map route boundaries to existing local qualification owners
method.limitations: ODA #1354 is one environment report and does not define universal package dependencies. ezdxf #1077 lacks a pinned ODA version, source/output hashes, isolated stage result, and inspected drawing. Repository/documentation branches are mutable. No peer or native runtime was exercised.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep ordinary implementation validation to the touched strict target, focused selector, owning CTest, and scoped diff check.
Keep required FreeCAD qualification on the explicit local dwg2dxf route; do not introduce ODA/Qt/X11 dependencies into the library or per-slice loop.
If ODA is selected for a composed comparison, preflight the exact executable and runtime/display environment once per platform; classify startup failure as ENVIRONMENT_NOT_RUN.
For a selected AC1021 MLEADER comparison, record same-version and R2013-upversioned routes separately with intermediate DXF version/hash and per-source identity/owner/disposition.
Do not add peer/customer drawings as fixtures; use existing permitted samples or locally authored scratch controls only.
